objectives_fil: Para sa Ampalaya, itugma ang botanical name, bahagi at nakalistang gamit. Ipaliwanag ang hangganan at konsultasyon.
objectives_en: For Ampalaya, match the botanical name, plant part and listed use. Explain the boundary and consultation need.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: May diabetes si Joel at gumagamit ng niresetang gamot
sections.takeaway_en: Case: Joel has diabetes and takes prescribed medicine

sections.takeaway_fil: Itugma ang dalawang Ampalaya card; piliin ang Momordica charantia, dahon, gamit at ligtas na susunod na hakbang.
sections.takeaway_en: Match two Ampalaya cards; choose Momordica charantia, leaves, use and safe next step.

sections.takeaway_fil: Dahon ng Momordica charantia ang nasa card; hindi ito dose.
sections.takeaway_en: The card lists leaves of Momordica charantia; this is not a dose.

check.prompt_fil: Aling bahagi ng Ampalaya ang nakalista sa card?
check.prompt_en: Which Ampalaya part is listed on the card?

options.fil: Anumang bahagi, dahil kilalang gulay ang ampalaya.
options.en: Any part, since Ampalaya is a familiar vegetable.

options.fil: Anumang bahaging banggitin ni Joel, nang hindi tinitingnan ang botanical name.
options.en: Whatever part Joel names, without checking the botanical name.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi sinasabi ng pagiging gulay ang nakalistang bahagi; dahon ang nasa card. 2: Dahon ng Momordica charantia ang nasa card; hindi ito dose. 3: Tingnan ang botanical name at bahagi sa card, hindi lang ang sinasabi ni Joel.
check.feedback_en: 1: Being familiar food does not tell you the listed part; the card lists leaves. 2: The card lists leaves of Momordica charantia; this is not a dose. 3: Check the botanical name and part on the card, not only what Joel says.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso ni Joel: tugma ang card, walang binago sa gamot, iniugnay sa clinician.
sections.takeaway_en: Joel’s case: card matched, medicine unchanged, question sent to his clinician.

sections.takeaway_fil: Hindi awtomatikong kapalit ang ampalaya; huwag ihinto o baguhin ang gamot.
sections.takeaway_en: Ampalaya is not an automatic substitute; do not stop or change medicine.

sections.takeaway_fil: Huwag baguhin ang gamot ni Joel; ang clinician ang magpapasya.
sections.takeaway_en: Keep Joel’s medicine unchanged; his clinician decides.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang ligtas na tugon sa kaso ni Joel?
check.prompt_en: What is the safe response in Joel’s case?

options.fil: Sabihin kay Joel na puwedeng ipalit ang ampalaya sa gamot dahil gulay ito.
options.en: Tell Joel Ampalaya can replace his medicine because it is a vegetable.

options.fil: Huwag baguhin ang gamot; iugnay ang tanong sa kanyang clinician.
options.en: Do not change his medicine; refer the question to his clinician.

options.fil: Imungkahing bawasan niya ang gamot at sabayan ito ng ampalaya.
options.en: Suggest he take less medicine and add Ampalaya alongside it.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi awtomatikong kapalit ng diabetes plan ang pagkain; maaaring maantala ang pangangalaga. 2: Ang clinician na sumusubaybay sa blood sugar at gamot ni Joel ang magpapasya. 3: Pagbabago ng gamot ang pagbabawas; ang clinician lamang niya ang magpapasya.
check.feedback_en: 1: Food is not an automatic substitute for a diabetes plan; care may be delayed. 2: The clinician monitoring Joel’s blood sugar and medicines decides. 3: Taking less medicine is a medication change; only his clinician decides.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa Lunes, ihambing ang dalawang Ampalaya card at ipasuri sa supervisor.
sections.takeaway_en: On Monday, compare two Ampalaya cards and review them with a supervisor.
